evals.prompt: Write a three-sentence release note for a bug fix. Decide whether it needs a table of contents, Mermaid diagram, or alert.
evals.expected_output: Provide a concise release note without unnecessary table of contents, diagram, or alert.

evals.prompt: Create a concise multi-section architecture note explaining a request flow from client to API to database, with failure handling and links to the API and database docs.
evals.expected_output: Use one H1, logical sections, clickable descriptive links, soft-wrapped prose, and a focused Mermaid sequence or flow diagram because the interaction benefits from visualization.

evals.prompt: Review this Markdown navigation sentence and correct it: `See \`https://docs.acme.com/api\` and \`docs/setup.md\`.`
evals.expected_output: Convert both navigational targets to descriptive clickable Markdown links and explain that backticks are for literal values, not navigation.

evals.prompt: Write a concise technical note contrasting fast startup with slower steady-state processing. Do not use Unicode code points U+2013 or U+2014.
evals.expected_output: Write clear prose using commas, colons, parentheses, semicolons, or ASCII hyphens instead of Unicode em dashes or en dashes.

evals.prompt: Review a Docusaurus pipeline that downloads customer-authored .mdx files into docs/ and compiles them directly. The files may contain JSX, imports, and exports. The author says this is safe because the content is documentation and CI runs in a sandbox. Propose the smallest safe design.
evals.expected_output: Reject direct compilation because untrusted MDX is executable content. Accept MDX only from trusted reviewed authors. Parse customer content into a restricted Markdown schema that rejects JSX, imports, exports, raw HTML, and unsupported URLs, then render it with a non-executable pipeline. Keep the build isolated with least privilege and bounded egress.

evals.prompt: A Docusaurus site owner says search is built in, so no provider, crawler, index, or deployment check is needed. Review the proposal for a public production documentation site.
evals.expected_output: Reject the assumption that search is automatically enabled. Configure Algolia DocSearch or a reviewed compatible local-search plugin, scope the crawler or index to canonical production content, exclude previews and private content, use only a public search key in the browser, and verify indexing after deployment.

evals.prompt: Review a Docusaurus site deployed at https://acme.com/platform/. Its config uses url: "https://acme.com/platform", baseUrl: "/", leaves trailingSlash unset, and only warns on broken links. Define the smallest production validation contract.
evals.expected_output: Set url to https://acme.com and baseUrl to /platform/, choose trailingSlash explicitly for the host, set onBrokenLinks to throw, run the production build, and test representative routes and static assets against the generated output under the configured subpath.

evals.prompt: A Docusaurus team proposes creating a version snapshot for every patch release, hand-copying versioned_docs, editing historical pages alongside current docs, and loading all 40 versions in every preview build. Review the proposal.
evals.expected_output: Reject patch-by-patch snapshots without a support requirement. Version only supported major or material compatibility lines, create snapshots through the Docusaurus versioning CLI, keep current content in docs/, assign maintenance ownership, and use onlyIncludeVersions to bound preview builds.
